responsibility: Implements the generic core of GCC’s Haifa RTL instruction scheduler: logical-UID and per-insn scheduler state management, priority calculation support, ready/queue handling, dispatch-window selection, speculative-motion bookkeeping, and hooks for target-specific scheduling behavior. It is the block/region-independent engine that schedules ready insns according to dependency-derived priorities and machine dispatch constraints, updates RTL scheduling metadata such as BB boundaries and register-use statistics, and provides helper entry points used by the region and EBB front ends in sched-rgn.c and sched-ebb.c.
